title: nan
authors: Lam M.; Dodds L.; Eid A.; Hester J.; Adib F.
key_contribution: Presents MiFly, a 6DoF drone self-localization system using a single mmWave backscatter anchor fused with IMU, operating in GPS-denied and low-visibility settings, with extensive evaluation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
